content.text: Goldenplus Electronics showcased embedded human-machine interface (HMI) technology at Taiwan Smart Agriweek 2026. Our exhibition displays included the Omni HMI and Omni PLC families, Aeternus HMI products, and Brilliant Development Environment (BDE), our visual GUI development environment.

The booth highlighted how graphical interfaces and embedded control hardware can be combined for equipment monitoring and automation applications. Visitors could explore a range of display sizes, control interfaces, and demonstrations on site.

items: Omni Display: HMI and PLC-oriented interface systems presented with integrated control features.
Aeternus Display: embedded displays for user-interface and peripheral integration applications.
Brilliant Development Environment: graphical interface design and software development workflow.
Application demonstrations: interactive control panels and prototype equipment displayed at the booth.

content.text:
Goldenplus recently delivered a customized embedded data acquisition and communication solution for a customer project.

The solution connects to external monitoring equipment through an RS232 interface, receives and processes binary data packets, and transmits monitoring information to a remote server over Ethernet.

This enables customers to integrate ECG waveform data and related monitoring parameters into their own software platforms for visualization, historical review, and further analysis.

items: RS232 communication for external equipment data acquisition
Binary packet parsing and frame integrity verification
ECG waveform data acquisition and processing
Ethernet connectivity and HTTP API data transmission
Real-time communication and upload status monitoring
Server-side data storage and historical waveform visualization
Integration with customer-developed web applications and analysis systems

content.text:
This project demonstrates Goldenplus's capabilities in embedded system development, hardware communication interfaces, and end-to-end data integration.

Goldenplus provides customized solutions for industrial and specialized equipment applications, helping customers connect existing devices to modern network-based monitoring and data management platforms.

imageAlt: Goldenplus Delivers Medical Monitoring Data Integration Solution
summary: Goldenplus has delivered a customized solution integrating RS232 data acquisition, ECG waveform processing, and Ethernet-based data transmission, enabling customers to collect, visualize, and analyze monitoring data through their own server platforms.
title: Goldenplus Delivers Medical Monitoring Data Integration Solution
